concerns.text: FR-007 and SC-001 require re-running the 3D baseline on the exact same task instances to generate a paired dataset. Task T023b ('Execute baseline_3d.py') is marked as incomplete ([ ]). Without this task being defined as executable and linked to the data generation output (T006b), the core requirement for paired comparison cannot be satisfied.

Constitution Principle I (Reproducibility) and Principle IV (Single Source of Truth) require documentation (README, API docs, Methodology section in research.md). Tasks T037a through T037e, which cover these mandatory documentation artifacts, are marked as incomplete/rejected ([ ]). This leaves the project without the required reproducibility records.

FR-008 requires 'at least 5 independent runs per task instance'. Task T017 implements the stochasticity control loop, but there is no explicit task to verify or enforce the 'N>=5' constraint in the orchestration logic (T009) or the statistical analysis (T029). The plan relies on T017's description, but a specific validation task for the run count is missing to ensure the statistical power requirement is met.

Task T035 is listed as '[P] [Edge] Implement memory fallback' in Phase 2, but the description references 'T035 moved to Phase 2' in the Phase 6 header. This creates a stale/contradictory reference in the text. While the task exists, the cross-reference text is confusing and should be cleaned up to avoid implementation ambiguity.
